[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec filter_and_sort (arr: List Int) (digits: List String) : List String :=
  match arr with
  | [] => []
  | head :: tail =>
    if 1 ≤ head ∧ head ≤ 9 then
      let idx := head - 1
      let name := digits[idx]
      name :: filter_and_sort tail digits
    else
      filter_and_sort tail digits

let reverse_and_map (arr: List String) : List String :=
  List.reverse (List.map (fun (s: String) => digits[List.idxOf s digits]) arr)

let implementation (arr: List Int) : List String :=
  let filtered_sorted = filter_and_sort arr ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]
  reverse_and_map filtered_sorted
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma idx_of_in_range
(s: String)
(digits: List String)
(h_s_in_digits: s ∈ digits)
: 0 ≤ List.idxOf s digits < digits.length
:=
by
have h_s_in_digits': List.mem_of_idxOf h_s_in_digits
  by simp [List.idxOf]
have h_digits_non_empty := List.non_empty_of_mem h_s_in_digits
have h_digits_length := List.length_non_zero h_digits_non_empty
have h_idx_non_neg := List.idxOf_non_neg h_s_in_digits
  by simp [h_s_in_digits']
have h_idx_lt_length := List.idxOf_lt_length h_s_in_digits
  by simp [h_s_in_digits']
exact ⟨h_idx_non_neg, h_idx_lt_length⟩

lemma filter_and_sort_correct
(arr: List Int)
(digits: List String)
(h_arr_non_empty: arr.length > 0)
: spec (filter_and_sort arr digits)
:=
by
have h_filter_sorted: (forall s: String, (s ∈ result → s ∈ digits)) ∧
  (arr.length ≥ result.length) ∧
  (forall x: Nat, ((x: Int) ∈ arr ∧ 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9) → (digits[x-1]! ∈ result)) :=
  by
  intros s h_s_in_result
  simp [filter_and_sort]
  simp [digits]
  have h_s_in_digits := List.mem_of_idxOf h_s_in_result
  simp [h_s_in_digits]
  exact h_s_in_digits
have h_sorted: List.Sorted Int.le (List.map (fun (s: String) => (List.idxOf s digits) + 1) (filter_and_sort arr digits)).reverse := by
  simp [filter_and_sort]
  simp [reverse_and_map]
  simp [List.map]
  simp [List.idxOf]
  simp [idx_of_in_range]
  have h_result_non_empty := List.non_empty_of_mem h_s_in_result
  have h_result_length := List.length_non_zero h_result_non_empty
  have h_result_sorted := List.Sorted_of_map h_result_non_empty h_s_in_result
  simp [h_result_sorted]
  simp [h_result_length]
  simp [List.map]
  simp [List.idxOf]
  simp [idx_of_in_range]
exact ⟨h_filter_sorted, h_sorted⟩
